stage1_vae_reconstruction.metric_note: Paired reconstruction metrics use predicted and ground-truth arrays in the original test coordinate frame. No rotation alignment is applied.
stage1_vae_reconstruction.cartesian_metric_note: The pretrained MP20 loss has loss_pos=0, so the raw Cartesian pos head is not directly supervised. Use fractional-coordinate and lattice errors, validity, and match rate for structural quality.

stage2_ldm_generation.metric_note: Stage 2 is unconditional generation conditioned only on atom count. Generated structures have no one-to-one ground-truth atom mapping, so paired RMSE/MAE are undefined. Match rate is a reference-hit rate against the corresponding test structure, not reconstruction accuracy.
